summary: ERock, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into material definitive agreements (Sixth A&R LLC Agreement, Tax Receivable Agreement, Registration Rights Agreement) in connection with its IPO closing. The IPO of Class A common stock priced on June 9, 2026, per the Rule 424(b) prospectus. The registrant also issued unregistered shares: 20,267,046 Class A and 171,226,057 Class B common stock to pre-IPO unit holders in reliance on Section 4(a)(2). This filing describes routine IPO-related structural and registration mechanics, not a change-of-control or discrete special-situation event. The SEC filing reflects a standard IPO closing and ongoing listing, with no pending special-situation trigger.
